chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Shu'ayb, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
He should not offer the sacrifice except with that by which he has performed the standing at 'Arafat.

key_terms.بِمَا: with that by which; referring to the qualifying condition
key_terms.عُرِّفَ: performed the standing at 'Arafat; was present at 'Arafah

ai.seo_question: Can a person offer the hajj sacrifice without having stood at 'Arafat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling connected to the rites of hajj and sacrificial offering. It states that the sacrifice is not to be offered except by one who has completed the required standing at 'Arafat.
